name: s08-metrictypes
title: Pick the metric type first
spec: A table of four rows, left column the metric type as a green chip, right column what it answers. Counter: only goes up, query with rate(). Gauge: moves up and down, temperature or queue depth. Histogram: bucketed observations with _sum and _count, latency distributions, can be aggregated (orange highlight). Summary: quantiles computed on the client, cannot be aggregated across instances.
cap: Metric types: counter, gauge, histogram and summary each answer a different question.

name: s08-cardinality
title: Bounded labels versus cardinality explosion
spec: Two panels. Left panel (green) Bounded labels: a metric name with labels host, gpu index, sensor and a small count of series. Right panel (orange) Unbounded labels: label user id, request id or timestamp, arrow to a growing pile of series labelled every new value makes a new series. Bottom bar: each unique label combination is its own time series.
cap: Labels need a bounded set of values, because every unique combination becomes its own time series.

name: s08-collector
title: A custom collector reads at scrape time
spec: A flow left to right: Prometheus ; GET /metrics every scrape interval ; exporter with a custom collector ; collect() reads the hardware now ; yields fresh metrics in the response. Orange note: no stale values are cached between scrapes. Green note: also expose an up metric and scrape_duration_seconds.
anchor: ### 4.3 The recommended way: a custom collector
alt: A custom collector at scrape time
cap: A custom collector gathers values when Prometheus scrapes, so the numbers are always fresh.

name: s08-redfish
title: The Redfish resource tree
spec: A tree: root box /redfish/v1/ (service root) with branches to four boxes: Systems (power state, BIOS, processors, memory), Chassis (enclosure, thermal, power, sensors, GPUs), Managers (the BMC itself, network, logs), UpdateService (firmware inventory). A green note: follow @odata.id links, do not hard-code vendor paths. An orange note: actions are POST requests to Actions/... targets.
cap: Redfish hangs everything off the service root, and resources link to each other with @odata.id.

name: s08-paginate
title: Walking every page
spec: A horizontal chain of three page boxes: page 1, page 2, page 3, joined by arrows labelled next link. The last page box has no next link and an arrow to a green box done: all items collected. Orange note: stop only when there is no next page, not when a page looks short.
cap: Pagination: follow the next link until none is left, so the result is complete.
